training_objective: Bidirectional paired-coordinate regression plus auxiliary momentum regularization. Every selected FIT parent and six capped readouts retained. This is supervised transport pretraining, not a new objective theorem or a Boltzmann density fit.
selection: All32 FIT parents in four compositions; no independent-evaluation or reserved outcomes. Identical sample/noise streams and initialization seed for the three ablations within each replica.
success_gate: Pretraining is a fast architecture screen only. Freeze final weights, then test actual corrected proposals on the pre-existing12 internal evaluation parents with all failures and true endpoint energy costs, followed by short chains if signal exists. No global optimization or perfect-case prerequisite.
